description: Caddy base images, the caddy-dns/cloudflare plugin and the workflow's actions. Merging a PR rebuilds and pushes ghcr.io/2stacks/caddy-cloudflare; the stacks that use it get their digest PRs in their own repo. Validate every PR before merging: stable releases only, read the release notes, the PR build must pass.

packageRules.description: Base images carry digests; digest PRs bring base-OS fixes
Builder and runtime base and the DNS plugin move together, so the image is rebuilt once
Major version bumps need a tick on the Dependency Dashboard first

customManagers.description: caddy-dns/cloudflare plugin version in the Dockerfile
